##Prework for excercise
```{r}
## Prework for Exercise

# Load required package
library(tseries)

# Load dataset
load("GSPC.RData")

# Inspect column names
colnames(GSPC)

# Extract adjusted closing prices
P <- GSPC[, "GSPC.Adjusted"]

# Remove missing values
P <- na.omit(P)

# Calculate log-returns
r <- 100 * diff(log(P))

# Remove missing values
r <- na.omit(r)

# Display first observations
head(P)
head(r)

# Summary statistics
summary(P)
summary(r)

#extra check!
length(P)
length(r)
```

##Question 1.1: Stationarity Tests

```{r}
# ADF test for adjusted closing prices
adf_price <- adf.test(P)

# ADF test for log-returns
adf_return <- adf.test(r)

# Display results
adf_price
adf_return
```
###Why not run a kpss test too?
```{r}
## KPSS Stationarity Tests

# KPSS test for adjusted closing prices
kpss_price <- kpss.test(P)

# KPSS test for log-returns
kpss_return <- kpss.test(r)

# Display results
kpss_price
kpss_return
```


## Question 1.2
```{r}
# Packages
library(moments)
library(tseries)

# Plot log-returns
plot(r,
     type = "l",
     col = "blue",
     main = "S&P 500 Log-Returns",
     ylab = "Return (%)",
     xlab = "Time")

abline(h = 0, col = "red")

# Skewness and kurtosis
skew_r <- skewness(as.numeric(r))
kurt_r <- kurtosis(as.numeric(r))

cat("Skewness =", skew_r, "\n")
cat("Kurtosis =", kurt_r, "\n")

Box.test(as.numeric(r), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(as.numeric(r), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(as.numeric(r), lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(as.numeric(r), lag = 40, type = "Ljung-Box")

# ACF plot
acf(as.numeric(r),
    main = "ACF of Log-Returns")
```

##1.3
```{r}
# Calculate squared log-returns (skip this if you already did it)
r_squared <- r^2

# Plot squared log-returns
plot(r_squared,
     type = "l",
     main = "Squared S&P 500 Log-Returns",
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Squared Log-Returns")

# Ljung-Box test on squared log-returns
Box.test(as.numeric(r_squared),
         lag = 20,
         type = "Ljung-Box")

acf(r_squared,
    main = "ACF of Squared S&P 500 Log-Returns",
    lag.max = 40)
```

##1.6
```{r}
library(rugarch)

# 1. Define the model from equations (2)-(4)
spec <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model     = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
  mean.model         = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "norm"
)

# 2. Estimate it by maximum likelihood
fit <- ugarchfit(spec = spec, data = r)

# 3. Parameter estimates with robust standard errors
round(fit@fit$robust.matcoef, 4)

# 4. Persistence
persistence <- coef(fit)["alpha1"] + coef(fit)["beta1"]
persistence
```


```{r}
# Standardized residuals (estimate of v_t)
z <- as.numeric(residuals(fit, standardize = TRUE))

# Test 1: autocorrelation in z (is the mean equation OK?)
Box.test(z, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Test 2: autocorrelation in z^2 (is the variance equation OK?)
# fitdf = 2 because 2 parameters (alpha1, beta1) were estimated in the variance
Box.test(z^2, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = 2)

# Test 3: remaining ARCH effects
ArchTest(z, lags = 20)

# Test 4: normality
library(moments)
skewness(z); kurtosis(z)
jarque.bera.test(z)
```

##1.8
```{r}
## Question 1.8

library(rugarch)

# Define GARCH(1,1) with Student-t innovations
spec_t <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
  mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "std"
)

# Estimate the model
fit_t <- ugarchfit(spec = spec_t, data = r)

# Display parameter estimates with robust standard errors
round(fit_t@fit$robust.matcoef, 4)

# Calculate volatility persistence
persistence_t <- coef(fit_t)["alpha1"] + coef(fit_t)["beta1"]
persistence_t
```
```{r}
# Standardized residuals
z_t <- as.numeric(residuals(fit_t, standardize = TRUE))

# Ljung-Box test on standardized residuals
Box.test(z_t, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box test on squared standardized residuals
Box.test(z_t^2, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = 2)

# ARCH-LM test
ArchTest(z_t, lags = 20)
```
##1.9
```{r}
## Question 1.9

# Compare log-likelihoods
likelihood(fit)
likelihood(fit_t)

# Compare information criteria
infocriteria(fit)
infocriteria(fit_t)

```

##1.10
```{r}
# Question 1.10: Threshold GARCH(1,1)

spec_tgarch <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(
    model = "gjrGARCH",
    garchOrder = c(1, 1)
  ),
  mean.model = list(
    armaOrder = c(0, 0),
    include.mean = TRUE
  ),
  distribution.model = "norm"
)

fit_tgarch <- ugarchfit(
  spec = spec_tgarch,
  data = r
)

# Parameter estimates
round(fit_tgarch@fit$robust.matcoef, 4)

# Model fit
likelihood(fit_tgarch)
infocriteria(fit_tgarch)
```
